data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterstadt assessed Sam Rivera's income tax for 2025 at 1,234.00 € and 0.00 € solidarity surcharge. Because 1,546.45 € was already withheld from wages, a refund of 312.45 € will be paid to the Musterbank eG account ending 2345 00. The notice is dated 15.09.2026 and can be challenged by objection (Einspruch) within the deadline stated.
data.explanation: This letter is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 from the Finanzamt (tax office). It shows your taxable income, the tax set (1,234.00 €), and that you overpaid through payroll withholding, so 312.45 € will be refunded to your bank account automatically — no action is needed for the refund itself. Keep this document, as you may need it later (e.g. for future tax returns or as proof of income). If you believe something is incorrect, you can file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt Musterstadt in writing, electronically, or in person, by the deadline shown. If you do nothing and agree with the figures, the assessment simply becomes final.
